messages.subject: lavInspect( ,what="post.check")
parts:
Hello,

i get the following warning "The variance-covariance matrix of the estimated parameters (vcov)  does not appear to be positive definite! The smallest eigenvalue  (= 2.583357e-16) is close to zero. This may be a symptom that the model is not identified.", 
but when I use the  lavInspect(model,what="post.check"), the result is TRUE. Is there any explanation for that?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lavInspect( ,what="post.check")
parts:
The help page says "Post-fitting check if the solution is admissible"
TRUE = the post-check found an inadmissible solution, so warn the user.
FALSE = not an inadmissible solution

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
